answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a mandatory inlet for network participation. An attacker must purchase substantial native assets to command voting power, driving the total cost to a nadir of economic viability only if they acquire a majority stake. Unlike non-collateralized systems, this ensures that any malicious actor risks the ferrous durability of their own wealth through slashing protocols, effectively pricing out large-scale identity forgery.
